why: The behind column is needed: with checked_at set after every turn and a list narrowed to documents issued after it, a book cut by DOCS_A_ROUND (100) or the 40 s deadline, a newly opened book's history, and the days added by opening the books earlier would all wait an hour per round. But the brief's exists() rule cannot be followed (no table has an index on (store_id, issued_at/created_at), so it drops every exists() and contradicts its own test), insert times miss documents that become due by a change of state, the ledger_waiting exists() is keyed by store and outlives its rows, and checked_at = now() at the turn's end loses what was issued during the turn. Keep the column, list on the two shop tables through their issued_on indexes plus the hourly look, mark caught-up books with the list's time, count the comparison's limit, and test deterministically through a round limit.
